headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 5, 2026, the portfolio set is showing a year-to-date return of 25.19%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.60%. This results in an average alpha of 11.59%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 47.10%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has a return of 18.08%, which still exceeds the benchmark but highlights the variance in performance across the portfolios. This outperformance relative to SPY is a useful signal during periods of market uncertainty, showcasing the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
